name: product-passport
description: Digital Product Passports on Hedera: an HTS NFT per product minted through the system contract, an HCS topic per product as its ordered lifecycle log, and a mirror-node indexer that reconciles custody claims against real NFT transfers.

sections.title: Explore it first — no account needed

steps.label: Start the app on bundled demo data
steps.text: Then open http://localhost:3000/verify/1 to see a passport, its lifecycle timeline and its verification status. No .env, no wallet, no network.

sections.title: Put a real passport on Hedera testnet

steps.label: 1. Create a deployer account
steps.text: Creates an ECDSA key and stores it encrypted. ECDSA is required for the EVM flows. Already have a funded Hedera account? Run yarn hardhat:account:import instead and paste its hex encoded private key.

steps.label: 2. Fund it
steps.text: Paste the address printed above. The bootstrap needs about 25 HBAR: roughly 2 to deploy, 20 for HTS token creation, 1 for the topic and its messages, and a small buffer. It tells you the exact shortfall before spending anything.

steps.label: 3. Bootstrap
steps.text: Deploys PassportRegistry, creates the NFT collection, creates the demo product's HCS topic, registers the product and submits its first events. Idempotent — safe to re-run.

steps.label: 4. Index it
steps.text: Replays the mirror node into a local SQLite index and reconciles every custody claim against the NFT's real transfer history.

steps.label: 5. Open the passport
steps.text: http://localhost:3000/verify/1 now renders live testnet data, with a HashScan link on every claim.
